sources.text: The Jazz Club at Aman New York | Exa | Jazz and Blues Venue 4.4 (190 reviews) … The drinks were the best I've had in NYC and for over $30 a drink, they better be. … Price Point $$$$$ Staff was very good, service was exceptional. … The private "members only" club is beautiful and sophisticated. … We had issues with our table, and they were accommodating and let us table hop to find the perfect spot. This exclusive jazz club with a speakeasy vibe in the heart of Manhattan offers live music and attracts a more mature crowd, yet the vibe stays lively and fun with plenty of people dancing. The drinks are unique, complex, and beautifully crafted, but perhaps a little too complex for me personally. They also check names and reservations before you can even enter the building.

summary.value: The Jazz Club at Aman New York is a hushed, speakeasy-style hideaway under the Crown Building where excellent cocktails, gracious service and live music come at a luxury price. Staff move guests to better tables when asked, and the subterranean Jazz Club suits a special late evening rather than a casual drop-in.

description.value: The Jazz Club at Aman New York is a subterranean jazz venue inside the hotel. Aman says Arva and Akari sit alongside the Lounge Bar, subterranean Jazz Club and a collection of alfresco dining terraces. The hotel occupies the Crown Building on the corner of Fifth Avenue and 57th Street; since 1921 it has stood there, and it was formerly the first home of the Museum of Modern Art. Reviews describe a speakeasy-style room with live music and dancing, cocktails ranked among the best in the city at top-tier prices, and exceptional service that helps guests find a better table.
